text:
julian: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I split the remediation work into three lanes: deterministic repro, slab/GC experiments, and short-term tenant guardrails. Posting owners + short ETAs. Please ack or reassign.
mira: I can own the deterministic repro and trace collection on staging. will run sweep across skew and growth-rate.
diego: I'll take slab GC experiments and a conservative canary rollout. plan to test frag_threshold bumps and compact-window tuning.
sam: ops will add tenant soft-multipliers and residency alerts. will also wire a synthetic eviction cron to exercise evictions nightly.
ops-bot: runbook link: infra/runbooks/kv-oom-guard.md
julian: repro checklist (mira): enable heap/alloc sampling, run 6h peak with skew sweep 0.6->0.95, QPS ramp to 20k, and collect kv-snap every 20m. upload to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/pm-2467890123/ and tag files with thread-2467890123.
mira: repro command I used locally:
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtraces
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=150 --skew-start=0.6 --skew-end=0.95 --step=0.05 --duration=21600 --alloc-sample=1% --heap-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/pm-2467890123-$(date +%s).tgz
```
diego: canary experiment plan:
- step A: frag_threshold 0.34 -> 0.50 (48h)
- step B: compact-window for hot shards 60s -> 25s (72h)
- step C: enable eager-evict for segments > 96MB on canary (72h)
Rollback criteria: any OOM or p99 read latency > 1.7x baseline. I'll add dashboard panels and a revert PR.
sam: ops tasks:
- add alert: residency-delta > 18% sustained 8m -> page oncall
- add tenant soft-multiplier default 0.9x for tenants above 95th percentile for 48h (opt-out)
- schedule synthetic eviction cron at 02:30 UTC and attach runbook
ci-bot: ticket created: OPS-8242 residency-delta alert (assignee: sam)
mira: repro observations so far: leak correlates with sustained alloc_delta > 30MB/s for >10m on shards with frag >0.42 and tenancy skew >0.8. I'll add pattern to the alert proposal.
diego: important note: eager-evict can increase eviction churn and p99 read latency on hottest keys. I'll instrument eviction_rate, eviction_latency, eviction_fail_pct, residency, frag, and alloc_delta/s.
julian: short-term mitigation Q: should we apply a temporary global soft limit per-tenant while canary runs? reduces blast radius but risks throttling big customers.
sam: we can implement as a feature-flag with opt-out per-tenant. ops to prepare RFC and rollout plan. ETA for proto rule: 6h.
mira: where should I upload traces and how do you want trace metadata?
julian: drop to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/pm-2467890123/ and include a small meta file with keys: pool, qps, skew, alloc_sample, heap_sample, and sha of repro harness. use infra/tools/kv-upload.sh to simplify.
mira: ack. I'll run tonight and post links. ETA 18h for first bundle.
diego: canary PR plan: make frag_threshold and eager-evict flags per-pool, include compact-window variant. will gate behind feature flag and add fast rollback steps in PR. ETA to open PR: 24h.
sam: ops will create alert ticket and RFC for soft-multiplier. will also add a quick-run emergency cap (global kill switch) if cluster-level residency > 0.82 for 15m. need SRE signoff for automatic global cap.
oncall: reminder: if canary shows OOMs, page #eng-oncall and reference this thread.
julian: ownership summary (confirm):
- deterministic repro & traces: mira (ETA 18h)
- slab/GC experiments & canary rollout: diego (PR ETA 24h, canary start after review)
- tenant guardrail & alerts: sam/ops (ETA 6h for tickets, RFC ETA 12h)
- retro writeup + metrics: julian (ETA 2026-06-05)
mira: confirmed. I'll include a short gist with harness steps and trace pointer when upload completes.
diego: I'll add dashboards and a canary dashboard snapshot in the PR.
sam: ops note: default soft-multiplier will be 0.9x for 48h; enterprise tenants can opt-out via support flow. I'll include rollback steps in RFC.
mira: early staging log that looks like the pattern: 
"[2026-05-21T03:14:09Z] shard=14 residency=0.80 alloc_delta=+39MB/s frag=0.44 gc_runs=2 eviction_rate=9/s"
julian: good. Let's reconvene in 48h with repro artifacts and canary metrics. If anyone sees a canary OOM, escalate to #eng-oncall immediately and ping this thread. Thanks all :rocket:
